=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/security_audit.sh:1639-1645 (the flattening loop and its comment) | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The comment "`gh api --paginate --slurp` yields one array per page; flatten them" is factually incorrect. The `--slurp` flag merges all paginated responses into a single flat JSON array for array-returning endpoints like `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues`.
  WHY: The code works correctly despite the misleading comment because the flattening logic handles both shapes (flat array of dicts via `append`, nested array of arrays via `extend`). However, the comment will mislead future maintainers about the actual API behavior. The test mock in `test_security_audit_files_every_new_finding_and_dedupes_across_pages` also returns a nested shape (`[[first_page, second_page]]`) that doesn't match the real flat-array output, though the code handles both.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===

  WHY: No runtime failure (flattening code handles both shapes via extend/append), but the inaccurate comment and mock will mislead future maintainers about the real endpoint contract.
